Name: Ministry of Oil
Profile: Government ministry overseeing Iraq's petroleum sector, including oil production, infrastructure, and contracts. Highest authority in Iraqi oil industry decisions.

Name: State Organization for Marketing of Oil
Profile: Iraq's official state marketing organization for crude oil exports. Manages Iraq's petroleum sales and export operations globally. Key entity in Iraq's oil revenue generation.

Name: China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC)
Profile: Chinese state-owned petroleum company with substantial investments in Iraqi oil fields. Major player in Iraqi upstream development.

Name: Iraqi Ministry of Electricity
Profile: Government ministry responsible for electricity generation, transmission, and distribution. Manages Iraq's power sector infrastructure and supply.

Name: Basra Oil Company
Profile: Major Iraqi state-owned oil production company. Operates oil fields in southern Iraq. Significant crude oil producer and exporter.

Name: Lukoil
Profile: Russian oil major with significant operations in Iraq. Operates oil fields and has development contracts. Major international operator in Iraqi petroleum sector.

Name: Shell (Royal Dutch Shell)
Profile: Major international oil company with operations in Iraq. Involved in oil and gas production and development contracts.

Name: Eni
Profile: Italian multinational oil and gas company with operations in Iraq. Engaged in oil field development and gas projects.

Name: Northern Oil Company
Profile: State-owned oil production company operating northern Iraqi oil fields. Manages operations in Kirkuk and surrounding regions.

Name: BP (British Petroleum)
Profile: British multinational oil and gas company with operations in Iraq. Involved in oil field development and production projects.

Name: Missan Oil Company
Profile: Iraqi state-owned petroleum producer operating in Missan Governorate. Engaged in oil field development and production.

Name: Exxon Mobil
Profile: American multinational oil and gas corporation with past involvement in Iraqi projects. Engaged in international oil operations.

Name: Gazprom
Profile: Russian natural gas company with involvement in Iraqi gas projects. Engaged in development and management of Iraqi gas reserves.
